author: ZelenskyyUa
text:
I met with representatives and leaders of the Ukrainian community in the United States. We discussed our diplomacy and efforts for peace, our engagement with President Trump and his team, and the main challenges and tasks Ukraine faces right now. Ending the war is the most important issue for our state. Preserving Ukraine, our nation, our historic and talented country.

I also presented awards to those whose work and support make an important contribution to strengthening Ukraine. I thank everyone who helps, who tells the truth about our fight, supports our people, and does everything possible to make sure Ukraine is heard and understood around the world. We deeply value all your support.
